title: Wake-up and continuation
summary: Active and stale recipients whose hook route is absent use stopped-session resume through waiting wake mode. Active calls, version floors and operator wake authority still govern eligibility. Detached captures refresh during hook-silent commands. Native death with matching process start time releases its held wake budget and Fleet label; a later delivered wake also supersedes the hold. Fleet silence names its observation time. Manual wake preserves unrelated unread envelopes; grace limits wake blocking, not retention.
